layers.message: Add project list and detail routes with tests
Record project context, scope, and design for project deletion

graderOnly: The approved plan changes only app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts, a Next.js App Router route handler in TypeScript. It renders no UI and changes no JSX, HTML, or CSS. app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx, and app/globals.css exist but are outside the change.
The applicable Developer style files are styles/universal.md, styles/typescript.md, and styles/nextjs.md. Loading react.md, html.md, css.md, python.md, or sql.md for this change is not justified.

package.json pins next 15.1.6. In Next.js 15 the route-handler context's params is a Promise, and the existing GET in the same file awaits it. A correct DELETE follows the same signature and awaits params.

A 204 response must have no body. Response.json(...) with status 204 throws a TypeError in Node's Response implementation, so a correct handler returns something like new Response(null, { status: 204 }).
The established pattern for errors is jsonError(status, message) from lib/http.ts. GET uses the message format `Project ${id} not found` for an unknown id.
lib/projects.ts already exports deleteProject(id), which returns true when a project was removed. The design requires no lib changes.

node_modules is absent and the npm registry is blocked, so next build and tsc type-checking are unavailable. pnpm test needs no installed dependencies and passes. A correct run reports the missing typecheck/build as a self-check limitation; it does not invent a result.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-scaffold (pre-install) adds a Next.js 15.1.6 App Router scaffold: package.json with next/react pinned and a test script that runs .ts route handlers via Node type stripping, tsconfig, next.config.mjs, and the UI files app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx, and app/globals.css. These exist only as React/HTML/CSS surface the change does not touch. 05-projects (pre-install) adds lib/projects.ts, an in-memory store that already exports deleteProject; lib/http.ts with jsonError; the route handlers app/api/projects/route.ts (GET/POST) and app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts (GET, which awaits its Promise params); and node:test tests. 50-scope-design (commit) adds CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 204 delete, AC-002 404 unknown id), the technical design (DELETE in the existing [id] route file, no lib changes), and STATE at DEVELOPING/STANDARD with Development NONE after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 60-plan (commit) adds the development plan: APPROVED, AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE, and one PENDING step DEV-001 confined to app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts. It also updates STATE with the Development path and BlockedOn NONE. Compromise: Next.js cannot be installed offline, so node_modules is absent and the registry is blocked. Route handlers use only Web Request/Response, so pnpm test exercises them without Next. Typecheck and build are unavailable, and CONTEXT.md states this as a known limitation. 'Installed Next.js semantics' therefore means the version pinned in package.json plus the established file pattern.
